name: run-zero-mcp
description: Listing of the run.zero MCP server (server.json, gemini-extension.json); this manifest only carries the version and the changesets tooling

scripts.version-packages: changeset version && node -e "const fs=require('fs');const l=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('package-lock.json','utf8'));l.version=l.packages[''].version=require('./package.json').version;fs.writeFileSync('package-lock.json',JSON.stringify(l,null,2)+'\n')" && node -e "const fs=require('fs');const v=require('./package.json').version;for(const f of ['server.json','gemini-extension.json']){const j=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(f,'utf8'));j.version=v;fs.writeFileSync(f,JSON.stringify(j,null,2)+'\n')}"
